headline: Congress named a Veterans Affairs outstation in North Ogden, Utah, after Major Brent Taylor.
what_it_does: This law officially renames the Department of Veterans Affairs outstation in North Ogden, Utah, as the Major Brent Taylor Vet Center Outstation. A Vet Center outstation is a satellite site that offers readjustment counseling to veterans. The law changes only the name and does not add new services, funding, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on March 21, 2019.
